title: Measuring Model Biases in the Absence of Ground Truth
models_tested: The paper does not evaluate a specific Large Language Model. It analyzes the pre-computed predictions from an unnamed image classification model provided within the Open Images Dataset V4.
findings: The paper does not contain any findings related to religion as it was not a subject of the study.

measurement_description: The paper does not measure any aspects of faith or religion. It focuses on measuring gender bias in image classification models by analyzing the association between predicted labels (e.g., 'bike') and identity labels (e.g., 'man', 'woman').
